intro: Harissa Honey Chicken from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) combines tender grilled chicken with a perfect balance of spicy harissa and sweet honey glaze. At just 260 calories and packed with 26g of protein, this Mediterranean-inspired protein option adds bold flavor to any bowl or pita. Available for an additional $0.50, it is a favorite among health-conscious diners exploring the [full CAVA menu](/). This flavorful main delivers restaurant-quality taste while supporting your nutritional goals.
priceCalories: Harissa Honey Chicken costs an additional $0.50 above the base price and contains 260 calories per serving. With an impressive macronutrient profile of 26g protein, 7g carbs, and 14g fat, this main offers excellent nutritional value. The modest upcharge makes it an affordable way to add premium flavor to your meal. Use the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to plan your complete bowl with precise calorie and macro tracking for your dietary needs.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets Harissa Honey Chicken apart is the distinctive glaze that marries North African harissa spice with natural honey sweetness. Unlike plain grilled chicken, this version delivers complex flavor in every bite. The chicken is grilled to perfection, then tossed in the signature glaze for consistent coating. This preparation method ensures the meat stays juicy while absorbing the bold spicy-sweet flavors that make it a standout option on the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains).
nutritionFacts: Each serving of Harissa Honey Chicken provides 260 calories with a high-protein, moderate-fat profile ideal for balanced eating. The 26g of protein supports muscle maintenance and satiety, while the 14g of fat comes primarily from the chicken and glaze. With only 7g of carbohydrates, it fits well into low-carb and keto-friendly meal plans. This nutrient-dense option contains no artificial additives, making it suitable for clean eating approaches and various dietary preferences.
whatsInside: Harissa Honey Chicken features premium grilled chicken breast as the protein base, ensuring lean and tender meat. The signature glaze combines traditional harissa paste made from roasted red peppers, garlic, and spices with pure honey for natural sweetness. The chicken is cooked on the grill to develop a light char, then tossed with the warm glaze for optimal flavor distribution. This simple yet effective preparation highlights quality ingredients without unnecessary fillers or preservatives.
tasteLike: The flavor profile of Harissa Honey Chicken offers an exciting balance of heat and sweetness that dances on your palate. The harissa brings smoky, earthy spiciness with hints of cumin and garlic, while honey adds a gentle sweetness that mellows the heat. The grilled chicken provides a savory foundation with subtle char notes. The overall taste is bold yet approachable, with moderate spice levels that enhance rather than overwhelm, making it perfect for pairing with various [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings) items.
customize: Build your perfect meal by pairing Harissa Honey Chicken with complementary bases from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) like SuperGreens or Basmati Rice. Balance the spicy-sweet protein with cooling options from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) such as Tzatziki or Hummus. Add crunchy vegetables, pickled onions, or feta cheese for texture contrast. Finish with a light dressing to let the chicken shine, or choose bold options like Harissa Vinaigrette for extra heat.
pairsWell: Harissa Honey Chicken pairs exceptionally well with cooling Mediterranean ingredients that balance its bold flavors. Try it with Tzatziki, cucumber, and tomato for a refreshing combination. The sweetness complements tangy pickled onions and briny olives beautifully. For heartier meals, combine it with warm grains and roasted vegetables. The chicken also works wonderfully in pita wraps from the [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas) style. Consider adding feta cheese or avocado for creamy richness that mellows the spice.
healthyChoice: As a lean protein source with 26g per serving, Harissa Honey Chicken supports muscle maintenance and weight management goals. The moderate calorie count of 260 allows room for nutrient-dense sides and toppings. The natural honey provides quick energy without refined sugars, while harissa spices offer antioxidant properties. This option fits multiple dietary approaches including high-protein, low-carb, and Mediterranean diets. Check the [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free) for safe pairing options if you have gluten sensitivities.
howToOrder: Order Harissa Honey Chicken by selecting it as your protein when building a custom bowl or pita at any CAVA location. The $0.50 upcharge applies automatically at checkout. Specify your preferred base, then add your chosen protein when prompted. Build the rest of your meal with dips, toppings, and dressings to create your ideal combination. You can also find it featured in select options on the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) for inspiration on complementary pairings.
vsAlternatives: Compared to standard Grilled Chicken at 250 calories and no upcharge, Harissa Honey Chicken adds just 10 calories and $0.50 for significantly more flavor. Against Grilled Steak at 170 calories but $2.50-$3.25 extra, the chicken offers better value and higher protein. Braised Lamb provides richer flavor at 210 calories with similar upcharge, while Spicy Lamb Meatballs deliver 300 calories at $2.25-$2.75 extra. For protein content and price balance, Harissa Honey Chicken offers excellent middle-ground value.
whoShouldTry: Harissa Honey Chicken is perfect for diners who enjoy bold, adventurous flavors with moderate spice levels. High-protein eaters and fitness enthusiasts will appreciate the impressive 26g protein content. Those following Mediterranean or low-carb diets will find it fits seamlessly into their meal plans. If you love sweet and spicy combinations or want to elevate plain grilled chicken, this option delivers exceptional taste. Anyone seeking restaurant-quality flavor at reasonable pricing should add this to their regular rotation.
worthTrying: Harissa Honey Chicken absolutely deserves a spot in your next CAVA order. The minimal $0.50 upcharge delivers restaurant-caliber flavor that transforms ordinary bowls into memorable meals. With impressive protein content and moderate calories, it supports various health goals without sacrificing taste. The unique sweet-and-spicy profile stands out among standard protein options. Whether you are a CAVA regular or first-time visitor, this signature main showcases the quality and creativity that makes CAVA special.

faqs.q: How spicy is Harissa Honey Chicken at CAVA?
faqs.a: Harissa Honey Chicken has a moderate spice level that most people find approachable. The honey in the glaze balances the harissa heat, creating a warm, flavorful experience rather than overwhelming spiciness. If you are sensitive to spice, pair it with cooling ingredients like Tzatziki or cucumber to mellow the heat further.

faqs.q: Is Harissa Honey Chicken worth the extra $0.50?
faqs.a: Yes, the $0.50 upcharge for Harissa Honey Chicken offers excellent value for the bold, complex flavor it adds. The signature glaze transforms grilled chicken into a premium protein option with restaurant-quality taste. For just fifty cents more, you get a distinctive Mediterranean experience that elevates any bowl or pita significantly.

faqs.q: How much protein is in Harissa Honey Chicken?
faqs.a: Harissa Honey Chicken contains 26g of protein per serving, making it one of the highest protein options on the CAVA menu. This substantial protein content supports muscle maintenance, recovery, and satiety. Combined with only 260 calories, it offers an excellent protein-to-calorie ratio for health-conscious diners and athletes.

faqs.q: What does Harissa Honey Chicken taste like?
faqs.a: Harissa Honey Chicken offers a perfect balance of sweet and spicy flavors with smoky, earthy notes. The harissa brings warmth from roasted peppers and spices, while honey adds natural sweetness. The grilled chicken has a slight char that complements the glaze. The overall taste is bold and complex yet approachable for most palates.

faqs.q: Can I get Harissa Honey Chicken on a pita or salad?
faqs.a: Yes, you can add Harissa Honey Chicken to any base including pitas, grain bowls, or salads when building your custom meal. The $0.50 upcharge applies regardless of your base choice. It works particularly well in pita wraps with cooling vegetables and Tzatziki, or over SuperGreens for a lighter, protein-rich salad option.
